away.summary: The Blackhawks open the season without captain Connor Bedard, who is out with a shoulder injury expected to last until November. Frank Nazar is penciled in as the No. 1 center between Roman Kantserov and Patrick Kane. The team has also loaned Dillon Boucher and Drew Commesso to the AHL, reducing the training camp roster to 26 players.

home.summary: The Golden Knights begin their 10th season with a projected lineup featuring Ivan Barbashev, Jack Eichel, and Mark Stone on the top line. Raphael Lavoie remains injured (undisclosed) and Dylan Coghlan is scratched. Trevor Connelly, the 2024 first-round pick, is expected to make his NHL debut.
